Container.Name: IPTV Tunerr
Container.Overview: IPTV to Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin tuner and XMLTV guide bridge.
Container.Description: IPTV Tunerr publishes a stable tuner endpoint, M3U playlist, and XMLTV guide from an IPTV provider or M3U source. It can relay live streams, cache guide data, and optionally use ffmpeg for remuxing or transcoding. The authenticated operator dashboard listens on port 48879. Keep both ports on a trusted LAN or VPN and set a strong dashboard password before starting.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: iptvtunerr iptv plex tuner xmltv m3u threadfin xteve jellyfin emby
Container.Changes: Initial Community Applications template. Tracks the GHCR latest image published by the IPTV Tunerr release workflow.
Container.Requires: Persistent appdata and cache paths. Set a reachable IPTV_TUNERR_BASE_URL before using Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Tuner Port
Config.Description: HTTP tuner, stream, playlist, and guide endpoint. Keep this on a trusted LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: Operator Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Authenticated Tunerr operator dashboard. Do not expose this port publicly.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Persistent guide and provider caches. This directory can grow with provider data.

Config.Name: Dashboard State File
Config.Description: Persistent operator dashboard preferences and state.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Required URL that Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin can reach, including the host port if remapped (for example http://192.168.1.20:5004).

Config.Name: M3U URL
Config.Description: Optional M3U source URL. Treat URLs containing credentials as secrets.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional Plex Media Server URL for automatic tuner registration.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional Plex token for automatic tuner registration.

Config.Name: API-Sports Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side API-Sports key for Sports Automation.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Required strong password for the operator dashboard.

Config.Name: Dashboard LAN Access
Config.Description: Allow the authenticated dashboard to accept connections on the mapped LAN port.
